traffic.name: c64cast
traffic.description: c64cast MULTICOLOR-hires (mhires) single-buffer host-DMA video writes (screen+color+bitmap). NOTE: c64cast's real DEFAULT display mode is mono `hires_edges` (see the `c64cast-hires` profile); this mhires profile is the heavier 3-write multicolor variant kept as a worst-case upper bound.

metadata.dirty_region_note: Full-frame worst case. Real c64cast diffs each region (c64cast backend.py:476-553) and a steady frame usually uploads a fraction of these bytes.
metadata.note: Video-only workload. Audio is a separate steady-state stream (see c64cast-with-audio).

traffic.name: c64cast-with-audio
traffic.description: c64cast mhires single-buffer video writes + 1 KB audio chunk to $4000 ring per frame. STATEFUL: writes $4000-$5FFF audio ring; do not run on a C64 you care about without the c64cast NMI/audio firmware loaded.

metadata.note: Adds one 1024-byte audio chunk per video frame. Real c64cast streams many small chunks; this is a per-frame aggregate representative.

traffic.name: c64cast-hires
traffic.description: c64cast REAL DEFAULT display mode: mono `hires_edges` single-buffer host-DMA video. Per frame: bitmap $2000 (8000 B) then screen $0400 (1000 B); NO color RAM write (mono hires has no per-cell color). Matches c64cast modes.py:2097-2098 write order. Full-frame worst case (dirty-region diffing usually sends less).

metadata.fps_target_note: 20 fps when digitized audio is streamed (the movie case); 30 NTSC / 25 PAL for video-only (c64cast config.py:2680-2702).
metadata.dirty_region_note: Full-frame worst case. Real c64cast diffs each region (c64cast backend.py:476-553) and a steady frame usually uploads a fraction of these bytes.
metadata.reu_note: On an REU-equipped U64 c64cast stages bitmap+screen via REUWRITE (0xFF07) + vblank flip instead of direct DMAWRITE; this profile models the direct host-DMA fallback path.

traffic.name: single-write
traffic.description: Protocol sanity profile: one small safe-RAM C64 write per unit
